📋 Skylint Rules Catalog (82 Rules) ​

Comprehensive reference for all 82 Clean ABAP, security, performance, and architecture rules in Skylint.

Clean ABAP & Modern Syntax (29) ​

Modern language features, expression-oriented coding, and idiomatic Clean ABAP practices.

Rule IDABAP ClassDescriptionFinding CodePseudo-CommentQuickFix
prefer-linesZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_LINESPrefer lines( ) built-in function over DESCRIBE TABLE ... LINESDESCRIBELN#EC LINES⚡ Ready
prefer-is-notZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_IS_NOTPrefer IS NOT over NOT ... ISPREFERISNT#EC IS_NOT⚡ Ready
prefer-string-templateZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_STR_TMPLPrefer string templates over CONCATENATECONCATSTR#EC STR_TMPL⚡ Ready
prefer-line-existsZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_LINE_EXISTSPrefer line_exists( ) over READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDSPREFLINEX#EC LINE_EXISTS—
prefer-returnZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_RETURNPrefer RETURN over EXIT outside loop constructsEXITOUTLP#EC RETURN⚡ Ready
merge-nested-ifsZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_MERGE_IFSDetect consecutive nested IF blocks that can be merged with ANDNESTEDIF#EC MERGE_IFS—
prefer-symbol-operatorsZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_SYMBOL_OPPrefer comparison operators (=, <>, <, >, <=, >=) over legacy textual keywordsPREFEROP#EC SYMBOL_OP⚡ Ready
prefer-new-operatorZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_NEW_OPPrefer NEW #( ) constructor expression over legacy CREATE OBJECTPREFERNEW#EC NEW_OP⚡ Ready
prefer-raise-newZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_RAISE_NEWPrefer RAISE EXCEPTION NEW over RAISE EXCEPTION TYPERAISEEXCNE#EC RAISE_NEW⚡ Ready
prefer-xsdboolZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_XSDBOOLPrefer xsdbool( ) expression over manual IF-ELSE assignmentPREFERXSDB#EC XSDBOOL⚡ Ready
require-fully-typedZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_FULL_TYPEDEnforce fully typed constant declarationsFULLYTYPED#EC FULL_TYPED—
prefer-correspondingZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_CORRESPPrefer CORRESPONDING Expression over MOVE-CORRESPONDINGPREFER_COR#EC CORRESP⚡ Ready
prefer-returningZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_RETURNINGPrefer RETURNING over single EXPORTINGPREFER_RET#EC RETURNING—
prefer-class-exceptionsZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_CLASS_EXCPrefer Class-Based Exceptions over Classic EXCEPTIONSCLASS_EXC#EC CLASS_EXC—
prefer-final-classZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_FINAL_CLSPrefer FINAL Classes by DefaultNOT_FINAL#EC FINAL_CLS—
prefer-insert-intoZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_INSERTPrefer INSERT ... INTO TABLE over APPEND for table safetyPREF_INSRT#EC INSERT_INTO⚡ Ready
clean-constructorZCL_SKYLINT_CLEAN_CTORKeep constructors clean; avoid heavy business logic/loops/DB accessCTOR_LOGIC#EC CLEAN_CTOR—
no-static-classesZCL_SKYLINT_NO_STATIC_CLSAvoid static-only classes; prefer instantiable interface-based designSTAT_CLASS#EC STATIC_CLS—
prefer-predicate-namesZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_PRED_NAMEEnforce predicate naming (IS_, HAS_, CAN_) on boolean methodsBOOL_NAME#EC PRED_NAME—
no-nested-tryZCL_SKYLINT_NO_NESTED_TRYAvoid nested TRY blocks; extract inner error handling to helper methodsNESTED_TRY#EC NESTED_TRY—
test-method-namingZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_TEST_NAMEEnforce test method naming convention (TEST_, SHOULD_) in AUnitTEST_NAME#EC TEST_NAME—
prefer-final-methodZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_FINAL_METHPrefer marking non-overridden methods as FINALPREF_FINAL#EC FINAL_METHOD⚡ Ready
prefer-string-functionsZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_STR_FUNCDetect obsolete string statements; prefer built-in functionsCONDENSE_S#EC STR_FUNC⚡ Ready
prefer-calc-assign-opZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_CALC_OPPrefer calculation assignment operators (+=, -=, *=, /=) over var = var + 1CALC_ASSGN#EC CALC_ASSIGN⚡ Ready
prefer-early-continueZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_EARLY_CONTUse early CONTINUE guard clause instead of wrapping loop in IF blockGUARD_LOOP#EC EARLY_CONTINUE—
prefer-early-returnZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_EARLY_RETUse early RETURN guard clause instead of wrapping method in IF blockGUARD_METH#EC EARLY_RETURN—
require-decl-orderZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_DECL_ORDEREnforce local declaration order (TYPES -> CONSTANTS -> DATA -> FIELD-SYMBOLS)DECL_ORDER#EC DECL_ORDER—
no-param-escapeZCL_SKYLINT_NO_PARAM_ESCAPEDetect unnecessary exclamation mark parameter escape (!iv_param)PARAM_ESCP#EC PARAM_ESCAPE⚡ Ready
prefer-caseZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_CASEChange IF to CASE when checking the same variable against multiple valuesUSE_CASE#EC PREF_CASE—

Anti-Patterns & Bad Practices (32) ​

Discouraged language constructs, legacy statements, and redundant syntax.

Rule IDABAP ClassDescriptionFinding CodePseudo-CommentQuickFix
no-call-methodZCL_SKYLINT_NO_CALL_METHODAvoid static CALL METHOD statementsCALLMETHOD#EC CALL_METH⚡ Ready
no-default-keyZCL_SKYLINT_NO_DEFAULT_KEYAvoid WITH DEFAULT KEY; prefer EMPTY KEY or explicit keysDEFAULTKEY#EC DEFAULT_KEY—
no-me-referenceZCL_SKYLINT_NO_ME_REFERENCEAvoid self-reference ME->AVOIDME#EC ME—
no-exportingZCL_SKYLINT_NO_EXPORTINGOmit explicit EXPORTING in method callsOMITEXPORT#EC EXPORTING⚡ Ready
no-chained-assignmentZCL_SKYLINT_NO_CHAIN_ASSIGNAvoid assignment chaining (a = b = c)ASSIGNCHN#EC CHAIN_ASSIGN⚡ Ready
no-chained-declZCL_SKYLINT_NO_CHAIN_DECLAvoid chained declarations (DATA:, TYPES:, etc.)CHAINDECL#EC CHAIN_DECL⚡ Ready
no-boolean-comparisonZCL_SKYLINT_NO_BOOL_COMPAREAvoid comparing boolean method calls to boolean literalsBOOLCOMP#EC BOOL_COMPARE⚡ Ready
no-check-in-loopZCL_SKYLINT_NO_CHECK_IN_LOOPAvoid CHECK in loop/iteration structures (prefer IF ... CONTINUE)CHKINLOOP#EC CHECK_IN_LOOP⚡ Ready
no-empty-blockZCL_SKYLINT_NO_EMPTY_BLOCKDetect empty control blocks (IF, CASE, LOOP, TRY, etc.)EMPTYCTRL#EC EMPTY_BLOCK—
no-empty-catchZCL_SKYLINT_NO_EMPTY_CATCHDetect empty CATCH blocks swallowing exceptionsEMPTYCATCH#EC NO_HANDLER—
no-duplicate-conditionsZCL_SKYLINT_NO_DUP_CONDDetect identical branch conditions in IF/ELSEIF and CASE/WHENDUPCOND#EC DUP_COND—
no-unreachable-codeZCL_SKYLINT_NO_UNREACHABLEDetect unreachable code following unconditional jump statementsUNREACHCD#EC UNREACHABLE⚡ Ready
no-single-whenZCL_SKYLINT_NO_SINGLE_WHENAvoid short CASE constructs with only one WHEN branch; prefer IFSHORTCASE#EC SINGLE_WHEN—
no-yoda-conditionsZCL_SKYLINT_NO_YODA_CONDAvoid Yoda conditions in comparison expressionsYODACOND#EC YODA_COND⚡ Ready
no-receivingZCL_SKYLINT_NO_RECEIVINGOmit RECEIVING in method callsOMITRECEIV#EC RECEIVING⚡ Ready
no-static-via-instanceZCL_SKYLINT_NO_STATIC_ARROWAvoid calling static methods via instance arrow (->)STATICVIAI#EC STATIC_ARROW⚡ Ready
no-public-attributesZCL_SKYLINT_NO_PUBLIC_ATTRAvoid mutable public attributes in classesNOPUBATTR#EC PUBLIC_ATTR—
no-obsolete-statementsZCL_SKYLINT_NO_OBSOLETEAvoid obsolete statements (MOVE, REFRESH, etc.)OBSOLETE#EC OBSOLETE⚡ Ready
no-scope-leakZCL_SKYLINT_NO_SCOPE_LEAKScope of variable (avoid variable leaking outside control blocks)SCOPELEAK#EC SCOPE_LEAK—
no-self-assignmentZCL_SKYLINT_NO_SELF_ASSIGNDetect Identical Self AssignmentsIDENTMOVE#EC SELF_ASSIGN⚡ Ready
no-single-param-nameZCL_SKYLINT_NO_PARAM_NAMEOmit parameter name in single parameter method callOMITPARM#EC PARAM_NAME⚡ Ready
no-try-without-catchZCL_SKYLINT_NO_TRY_NO_CATCHDetect TRY without CATCHTRYWITHOUT#EC TRY_NO_CATCH—
no-sy-modifyZCL_SKYLINT_NO_SY_MODIFYAvoid sy-* System Variable ModificationSYS_VAR_MD#EC SY_MODIFY—
no-raise-shortdumpZCL_SKYLINT_NO_SHORTDUMPAvoid RAISE SHORTDUMP (prefer graceful exceptions)SHORTDUMP#EC SHORTDUMP—
no-magic-numbersZCL_SKYLINT_NO_MAGIC_NUMBERSAvoid magic numbers in code; use named constantsMAGIC_NUM#EC MAGIC_NUMBERS—
no-obsolete-loop-controlZCL_SKYLINT_NO_OBS_LOOP_CTLAvoid obsolete control statements (ON CHANGE OF, AT NEW, SUM) in LOOPOBS_L_CTRL#EC OBS_LOOP_CTL—
no-like-objectsZCL_SKYLINT_NO_LIKE_OBJECTSAvoid LIKE referencing data objects; use explicit TYPEAVOID_LIKE#EC LIKE_OBJECTS—
no-interface-dataZCL_SKYLINT_NO_INTF_DATAAvoid mutable DATA declarations in interfaces; allow only CONSTANTSINTF_DATA#EC INTF_DATA—
no-message-raisingZCL_SKYLINT_NO_MSG_RAISINGAvoid obsolete MESSAGE ... RAISING; use class-based exceptionsMSG_RAISE#EC MSG_RAISING—
no-form-routinesZCL_SKYLINT_NO_FORMAvoid obsolete FORM routines; use modern methods in ABAP CloudAVOID_FORM#EC NO_FORM—
no-unused-variablesZCL_SKYLINT_NO_UNUSED_VARSDetect unused local variables and field symbolsUNUSED_VAR#EC NEEDED—
no-inline-lengthZCL_SKYLINT_NO_INLINE_LENAvoid inline length specification in declarationsPAREN_LEN#EC PAREN_LEN⚡ Ready

Performance & Database (5) ​

Database query efficiency, buffer protection, and internal table operation guidelines.

Rule IDABAP ClassDescriptionFinding CodePseudo-CommentQuickFix
no-db-in-loopZCL_SKYLINT_NO_DB_IN_LOOPAvoid database access inside loop iterationsDBINLOOP#EC DB_IN_LOOP—
no-empty-faeZCL_SKYLINT_NO_EMPTY_FAEUnsecure FOR ALL ENTRIES (Missing empty itab check)FAENOCHECK#EC EMPTY_FAE⚡ Ready
no-select-starZCL_SKYLINT_NO_SELECT_STARSelect performance (Avoid SELECT * and SELECT ... ENDSELECT)SELECTSTAR#EC SELECT_STAR—
require-order-byZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_ORDER_BYSELECT UP TO 1 ROWS requires ORDER BYSELECT_UP#EC ORDER_BY—
require-transportingZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_TRANSPORTAvoid full-line MODIFY itab inside LOOP without TRANSPORTING clauseFULL_MODIF#EC TRANSPORTING—

Security & Robustness (10) ​

Authorizations, dynamic execution sanitation, error handling, and runtime safety.

Rule IDABAP ClassDescriptionFinding CodePseudo-CommentQuickFix
no-dangerous-dynamicZCL_SKYLINT_NO_DYNAMIC_STMTDangerous / Unmanaged Dynamic StatementsDANGER_STM#EC DYNAMIC_STMT—
require-auth-checkZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_AUTH_CHECKCall Transaction Authority CheckAUTH_CHECK#EC AUTH_CHECK⚡ Ready
no-catch-cx-rootZCL_SKYLINT_NO_CATCH_ROOTAvoid generic CATCH cx_root; catch specific exception classesCATCH_ROOT#EC CATCH_ROOT—
no-raise-cx-syZCL_SKYLINT_NO_RAISE_CX_SYAvoid raising SAP internal system exceptions (cx_sy_*)RAISE_SYS#EC RAISE_CX_SY—
require-subrc-checkZCL_SKYLINT_CHECK_SUBRCCheck sy-subrc after DB, table and string operationsCHECKSUBRC#EC CHECK_SUBRC—
no-client-specifiedZCL_SKYLINT_NO_CLIENT_SPECAvoid USING CLIENT or CLIENT SPECIFIED in ABAP SQLCLIENT_SPE#EC CLIENT_SPEC⚡ Ready
no-commit-workZCL_SKYLINT_NO_COMMIT_WORKAvoid COMMIT WORK / ROLLBACK WORK in behavior implementationsNO_COMMIT#EC COMMIT_WORK—
no-raw-dynamic-sqlZCL_SKYLINT_NO_RAW_DYN_SQLAvoid dynamic SQL table or clause names without sanitizationDYN_SQL#EC RAW_DYN_SQL—
no-production-assertZCL_SKYLINT_NO_PROD_ASSERTDetect native ASSERT in production code; use exceptions insteadPROD_ASSRT#EC PROD_ASSERT—
no-forbidden-statementsZCL_SKYLINT_NO_FORBIDDENAvoid use of certain statements (BREAK, STATICS, DEFINE, EXPORT)AVOID_USE#EC FORBIDDEN—

Metrics & Complexity Limits (6) ​

Quantitative boundaries for method size, nesting depth, parameter counts, and cyclomatic complexity.

Rule IDABAP ClassDescriptionFinding CodePseudo-CommentQuickFix
max-paramsZCL_SKYLINT_MAX_PARAMSMethod signature cleanliness (excessive parameter count)PARAMCOUNT#EC MAX_PARAMS—
max-method-lengthZCL_SKYLINT_MAX_METHOD_LENMethod Length Limit (excessive statement count)METHOD_LEN#EC METHOD_LEN—
max-nesting-depthZCL_SKYLINT_MAX_NESTINGNesting Depth Limit (excessive control block nesting)NESTING_DP#EC NESTING—
max-cyclomatic-complexityZCL_SKYLINT_MAX_CYCLO_COMPCyclomatic Complexity ThresholdCYCLO_COMP#EC CYCLO_COMP—
max-inheritance-depthZCL_SKYLINT_MAX_INHERITAvoid deep class inheritance hierarchiesDEEP_INHRT#EC INHERIT_DEPTH—
max-attributesZCL_SKYLINT_MAX_ATTRIBUTESLimit number of member attributes in a class (God Class smell)ATTR_COUNT#EC ATTRIBUTES—
